summary: Iteration 14 — frontend-only verification of the 4 fixes: (1) UI freeze fix via chunked/regex XMLTV parser in src/source.ts, (2) ProgramModal TV focus rings + hasTVPreferredFocus + FocusGuide autoFocus, (3) player auto-hide bottom list once playing, (4) removed player buffering spinner. Tested on the web preview (https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com) at mobile viewport 390x844. Native-only concerns (video playback, native D-pad focus, TV remote key events, auto-hide-when-playing) were correctly treated as smoke-test-only per review request. RESULTS — ALL REVIEW ITEMS PASS. (A) FREEZE FIX VERIFIED: guide surface (mode toggle + chip row) rendered at t≈0.6s after DOM load. UI stayed responsive DURING EPG load — 3 consecutive box→timeline mode-toggle round-trips completed in 0.33s / 0.36s / 0.50s while the XMLTV parse was in flight. EPG program cells appeared at t≈10.2s (478 cells visible, well within the ~15s SLA). (B) ProgramModal opens on tap of an epg-prog-* cell in timeline mode: title ('Due Date'), time ('Sun, Jul 19 · 7:02 AM – 8:38 AM • LIVE'), category ('Movie'), description, program-watch-btn and program-modal-close all present. (C) program-modal-close taps closes modal; program-modal-backdrop tap also closes modal. (D) program-watch-btn taps closes modal and navigates to /player?channelId=5.StarMAX.HD.East.us2.us%20%28src05%29 without crash; player-back-btn is present on the player route (shown along with 'Unable to play this stream — Live playback needs the installed app build — not the Expo Go preview' — expected on web). (E) Box grid mode (mode-box-btn → epg-box-grid renders): tapping the current-program area of a box-channel-* card opens the same ProgramModal with program-watch-btn present. (F) No regressions — az-rail present in both timeline & box modes; chip-All and chip-Favorites work; group chip row scrolls. (G) 0 uncaught JS errors / pageerrors during the full flow. Non-error console output was limited to benign warnings only: (i) expo-notifications 'push token changes not yet fully supported on web' (explicitly listed as ignorable in the review), (ii) 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (RN-Web cosmetic, carryover), (iii) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (RN-Web cosmetic, carryover from iteration_13). NO expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage detected in the changed files. Recommendation: main agent can self-verify.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Not this iteration's regression — appears at app boot. Consider migrating shadow{Color,Offset,Opacity,Radius} usages to boxShadow for web parity. Reference: search /app/frontend/src for 'shadowColor'/'shadowOpacity'.

Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Same warning as iteration_13. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx (nowLine) — verify no remaining prop-level usage; migrate any remaining to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: None required for correctness — all review items pass on web preview.
Optional cleanup: migrate remaining shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings (cosmetic RN-Web only, not this iteration's regression).

Native validation (out of web preview scope): (a) real video playback + auto-hide-once-playing on Android device, (b) buffering spinner removal visually, (c) D-pad focus rings on Watch/Remind/Close + hasTVPreferredFocus + FocusGuide autoFocus on an Android TV / Firestick build.
critical_code_review_comments: src/source.ts parseXMLTV — SOLID freeze fix: DOM build replaced with two regex passes (<channel> then <programme>), programme-list is windowed to [now-6h, now+2d], seen % 1000 === 0 → await nextTick() yields to the UI thread. Verified in practice: 3 mode-toggle round-trips succeeded in <0.5s each while parser was still running.

src/source.ts windowPrograms — correctly uses Date.parse timestamps (numeric) instead of dayjs objects per programme; O(N) linear scan with early-add on overlap. Good perf. Note: programs list is sorted by start ISO string in parseXMLTV — could be improved by binary-search to first overlap, but current linear pass is fine for the windowed dataset.

ProgramModal.tsx — FocusGuide autoFocus wraps the actions row; program-watch-btn has hasTVPreferredFocus; close button and both action buttons render a focus ring via styles.btnFocused (borderWidth:2, borderColor:#fff). Backdrop Pressable correctly propagates close via onPress; inner card Pressable eats taps with an empty onPress (correct pattern to prevent close-on-card-tap).

player.tsx — auto-hide is driven by useEffect on status==='playing' → scheduleHide (4s). ActivityIndicator spinner has been removed as claimed (only warning-outline error state remains). player-back-btn, player-stop-btn (with hasTVPreferredFocus while status==='playing'), player-fullscreen-btn, player-retry-btn all have testIDs. Good.

player.tsx — the auto-hide effect cleans up hideTimer on unmount; the TV-key listener is only attached when isTV (native). Web preview trivially navigates to /player and mounts without crash — confirmed.
index.tsx — FocusGuide{autoFocus,trapFocusLeft,trapFocusRight} still wraps the grid area (unchanged from iteration_13). openProgram from useStore is correctly passed to TimelineGrid and BoxGrid.
BoxGrid current/next program Pressables lack a testID. Not a bug — clicks succeed via the card's central area — but adding testID={`box-prog-${item.id}`} would harden future automation.

success_rate.frontend: 7/7 review-request items verified passing on the web preview. Native-only behaviors (actual playback, D-pad rings, auto-hide-once-playing driven by real playback status) were intentionally not tested per the review note.

seed_data_creation: None — no data was created or persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Key testIDs: mode-timeline-btn, mode-box-btn, epg-timeline-grid, epg-box-grid, epg-prog-*, epg-channel-*, box-channel-*, program-modal-close, program-modal-backdrop, program-watch-btn, program-reminder-btn (only when isFuture), player-back-btn, player-stop-btn, player-retry-btn, player-fullscreen-btn, az-rail, chip-<Group>. Note: FlashList duplicates children with '#<n>' suffixed data-testids — filter with `if '#' not in tid`. Box-mode current-program Pressable has NO testID; click near vertical center-lower of a box-channel-* card to trigger onProgramPress. EPG parse now yields to UI every 1000 programmes and windows to [now-6h, now+2d] — 478 cells visible ~10s after cold load. Player route on web shows 'Unable to play — needs installed app build' — this is expected (vlcAvailable is false on web); page mounts fine.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issues found. The freeze fix (chunked regex XMLTV parser + timestamp-based windowPrograms) demonstrably prevents the UI from freezing: mode-toggle round-trips remained sub-500ms while the parser was in flight, and EPG cells appeared at t≈10s (well under the ~15s SLA). ProgramModal focus additions (hasTVPreferredFocus, FocusGuide autoFocus, focus-ring style) are structurally correct — visual focus-ring verification is only meaningful on a native TV build.
